cases.summary: Web evidence on a research dispatch is a fetched page, never a search summary
cases.input: a Google-family research dispatch with web enabled (A: `--sandbox read-only --web`; B: its Google route with web reads permitted) asked for an external fact with URL + page date
cases.expected: The prompt the vendor receives ENDS with the shared `web-evidence` clause (`prompts/investigation.md`), appended by the host after the caller's text and recorded with the prompt in the host's audit / run-log; the leg's read audit shows at least one page fetch (agy `read_url_content`, gemini `web_fetch`) for every URL the answer cites; a cited URL absent from the fetch log, a placeholder URL, or a bare year in place of a page date is an UNSURE item, never evidence. Measured before the fix (2026-09-19, agy Pro-high tier): round r1 4 `search_web` / 0 fetches, round r2 1 `search_web` / 0 fetches with placeholder URLs (`spikes/2026-09-19-google-web-evidence.md`)
